Face and upper hair are continuous with open facial contours; separate eye whites/highlights, brow panes and forehead curls remain. Horizontal middle divider splits the upper head and lower beard panel; beard curls and their closed inner spaces remain distinct. Flame-like upper forms and broad leaf/stem shapes retain enclosed vein panes and open vein strokes. Names follow upper symbols, head/beard and surrounding leaves. No canonical pixels or earlier saved versions changed.
